name: relay-hub
description: Relay Hub browser extension and desktop client.

scripts.build:tauri:linux: node scripts/run-tauri.js build --bundles deb,rpm && node scripts/collect-release.js
scripts.build:tauri:windows-gnu-exe: node scripts/run-rustup.js target add x86_64-pc-windows-gnu && node scripts/run-tauri.js build --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu --no-bundle && node scripts/collect-release.js
scripts.build:tauri:windows-msvc-exe: node scripts/run-rustup.js target add x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && node scripts/run-tauri.js build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --no-bundle && node scripts/collect-release.js
scripts.check: node --check src/host.js src/app.js src/background.js src/shell.js client/electron/main.js client/electron/preload.js client/electron/renderer.js client/tauri/tauri-shell.js scripts/prepare-tauri.js scripts/collect-release.js scripts/run-tauri.js scripts/run-rustup.js
